title: Little dragon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='body' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#7dffb3'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#2ecc71'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='belly' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffe066'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ffcc00'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='wing' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff9f7f'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#ff6b4a'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M30 78 Q15 85 8 72 Q4 64 12 60 Q20 58 24 68 Z' fill='#2ecc71' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M8 72 Q3 66 8 60 Q12 56 16 62 Z' fill='#ff9f7f'/>

  <!-- Wings -->
  <path d='M32 48 Q18 30 22 18 Q28 24 34 38 Z' fill='url(#wing)' stroke='#ffb89e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M36 46 Q28 32 30 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffb89e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M68 48 Q82 30 78 18 Q72 24 66 38 Z' fill='url(#wing)' stroke='#ffb89e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M64 46 Q72 32 70 24' fill='none' stroke='#ffb89e' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='26' ry='22' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='15' ry='13' fill='url(#belly)' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Feet -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='86' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#27ae60' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='86' rx='9' ry='5' fill='#27ae60' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='34' rx='22' ry='19' fill='url(#body)' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='42' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#58e89e' stroke='#7dffb3' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <circle cx='45' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#1a5c38'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='40' r='1.8' fill='#1a5c38'/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='41' cy='31' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fff' stroke='#a0ffd0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='59' cy='31' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#fff' stroke='#a0ffd0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <circle cx='42.5' cy='31' r='3.2' fill='#1a5c38'/>
  <circle cx='60.5' cy='31' r='3.2' fill='#1a5c38'/>
  <circle cx='43.5' cy='29.5' r='1.3' fill='#fff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='29.5' r='1.3' fill='#fff'/>

  <!-- Eyebrows -->
  <path d='M35 24 Q41 21 47 23' fill='none' stroke='#27ae60' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M53 23 Q59 21 65 24' fill='none' stroke='#27ae60' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M43 45 Q50 50 57 45' fill='none' stroke='#1a5c38' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9f7f' opacity='0.7'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#ff9f7f' opacity='0.7'/>

  <!-- Horns -->
  <path d='M36 17 Q33 8 28 6 Q32 12 32 18 Z' fill='#ffcc00' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M64 17 Q67 8 72 6 Q68 12 68 18 Z' fill='#ffcc00' stroke='#ffe680' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Spines -->
  <path d='M42 16 L45 10 L48 16 Z' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
  <path d='M48 14 L50 7 L52 14 Z' fill='#ff6b4a'/>
  <path d='M52 16 L55 10 L58 16 Z' fill='#ff6b4a'/>

  <!-- Arms -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#27ae60' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='58' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#27ae60' stroke='#58e89e' stroke-width='1'/>
</svg>
